NODE: PROTOCOL - A fully immersive hacking sim based on real exploits and C2 tools. Choose missions or pure free-roam. The world adapts to your every move, and strikes back.

You don't need real-world cyber experience; the game teaches you every tool and tactic from the ground up.

Key gameplay: 

  • Realistic terminal hacking pipelines. 98+ commands. More than 85 authentic exploits including rootkits. 

  • Physics-Driven Hardware - Real-time thermal simulation, power draw, GPU load, noise, and throttling. Overheat mid-hack and your rig literally slows down.

  • Living Trace & Heat System, Every action leaves dual-track logs (network + filesystem). Heat builds, trace speeds up, LTE burner failover, VPN phone-home risk, and full Fed Raid consequences that strip progress but never end the game.

  • Economy & Crypto, volatile in-game crypto economy., tainted wallets, multi-tier tumbling, blockchain forensics missions, and on-the-fly mining on compromised servers.

  • 250 Domains,  2,250+ Persistent targets, containing over 3,000 LAN nodes. Every server is real. High variety of OS layers, including vlans and security devices.

Advanced systems: 

  • SIGINT & Phone Warfare - Signal Decoupler app: IMSI catching, SS7 exploits, zero-click iPhone chains, MFA interception, evil_twin and live waterfall spectrogram.

  • C2 + Postal Delivery, Deploy beacons, run phishing campaigns, and physically deliver BadUSB payloads via courier with customs risk and tracking logs.

  • 5 Ruthless Rival Hackers, reach high trust and they start harassing you - eliminate them permanently or get hunted.

  • Dynamic Botnet & DDoS - Infect servers with bots or automate this with worms, launch city-wide attacks, and manage CSI detection index.

Multiplayer & Social Layer

  • Full Co-op Crew Mode (up to 4 players). Shared exploits, proxy chains, crew operations (root entire LANs together), real-time MeshLink chat + voice, host-authoritative sync, and crew leaderboards.

  • CTF, (Wargames) with up to two teams competing for the same target network. Can be played 2vs2, 3vs3, 4vs4. With leaderboards. 3 different matches, Sprint, Standard and Endurance. 

  • Property Empire. Own 15 safehouses with unique bonuses, trace reduction, hash rate boost, EMP shield, raid protection. 

Mission & World Design

Targets real persistent infrastructure with massive variety in outcomes. Missions include;

  • 33 Mission Types, that are replayable with variety in targets and outcome. Hack banks, government agency's, internet providers or shady underground forums.  

  • Every mission triggers real world chaos, rivals react, corporations seek revenge, news spreads, and the entire game adapts. Play both sides of the conflict and watch how it ends. 

Every mission hits real infrastructure.

Every failure leaves a trace.

Every success makes you the most wanted hacker alive.

------

“Uplink was the beginning. This is the endgame.”

EVERY SONG IS A BOSS FIGHT

NODGE is a neon rhythm shooter. Each track hides its own boss, and the whole fight is written to the music: every bullet wave, laser sweep and closing wall lands on the beat or tries to . Learn the

song, and you learn the fight.

THE FIGHT CHANGES WITH THE SONG

When the music shifts, so does the battle:

  • Arena: orbit the boss on its rings and weave through bullet storms

  • Side-scroller: chase it across the screen through bullet walls and seekers

  • Survive: no weapons, just you against closing rings until the timer runs out

  • Tunnel grid: dive down a 3D tunnel, jump lanes and dodge to break its core

DODGE ON THE BEAT, STRIKE ON THE BEAT

Your ship fires on its own, so your attention goes where it matters: dodging and timing.

  • Teleport through danger

  • Stasis freezes bullets in a shockwave

  • Barrier bends lasers away from you

  • Grazing bullets recharges your abilities, so the closer you play, the more you can do

Pick up weapon upgrades (Twin, Spread, Lance, Seeker), overdrive and shield cells mid-fight. Three shields. Make them count.

BOSSES WITH PERSONALITY

THE MAINFRAME fights with live circuit traces, binary walls and a firewall you have to outlast.

THE WATCHER, a demonic eye, floods the arena with bullet storms and seals you in containment rings.

Every boss looks, sounds and fights differently, and gets its own visual world built around its song.

CLASSIC MODE

The original NODGE is still here: no ship, no upgrades, no safety net. Obstacles fly at you from everywhere, all synced to the track. One mistake and it's over. Instant retry.

FEATURES

  • Hand-authored boss fights synced to every beat

  • Normal and Hard: same fight, tuned for your skill

  • End-of-fight grades. Can you beat a boss without taking a hit?

  • Global leaderboards for boss and classic modes

Try the free demo: two tracks, two bosses, and classic mode.

Your partner is trapped, and the walls of your shelter are cracking under the onslaught of creatures. You won’t survive this alone. Coordinate your defense, pull each other from the jaws of death, and when things go wrong, at least make sure your teammates hear about it - voice chat is on by default.

Scavenge for resources, repair devices, and build your own traps. Creativity is your greatest weapon. If you’re not prepared when night falls, it won’t spare anyone.

<NUGU?NUGU!: A HIDE AND SEEK BATTLE ROYALE> is a real-time hide-and-seek battle royale that combines intense psychological warfare with chaotic party game fun, all on a single shared screen. Your only goal is to blend perfectly into the crowd and survive to be the last one standing.

Key Features

Pickpocket & Upgrade: Stealthily steal gold from the crowd to get quirky items and deadly weapons. Use them wisely to turn the tide of the game.

Act Like an AI: Move, stop, and behave naturally among dozens of identical NPCs to deceive other players and hide your true identity.

Tactical Assassination: When you spot someone acting suspicious, strike! But be careful—attacking an innocent NPC could exposes your location.

NULL FACTORY is a first-person horror and suspense experience where you struggle to survive in the dark corridors of an abandoned industrial facility.

You are here to uncover what happened behind the closed doors of this factory, which has been forgotten for years and now ruled by silence and rust. But remember; you are not alone. The low-frequency hum echoing from the depths of the factory and the movement within the shadows are the ultimate proof that you are the hunted, not the hunter.

All you have is your courage and old notes that shed light on the factory's past. Check every corner carefully, analyze every clue, and use your wits to escape from the entity that is watching you.

Key Features:

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Feel the horror deep in your bones with realistic visual designs and dynamic sound effects that will keep you on edge.

  • Mysterious Clues: Collect and examine the notes you find to bring the dark secrets hidden by the factory to light.

  • Challenging Puzzles: Interact with the mechanics around you to find your escape route and seek ways to unlock secured doors.

  • Tense Gameplay: Hide from your enemy, move silently, and always remember that every step you take comes with a risk.

NULL VECTOR is a top-down survival tower-defense game built from neon geometry. Defend the central core while directly controlling an operator unit: move, aim, fire, and deploy active skills before enemies break through your defense.

BUILD YOUR DEFENSE

Research core, operator, and system upgrades. During preparation phases, place fortifications and adjust weapons, active skills, and passive bonuses. Enemies can carry combinations of shields, healing, dashes, splitting, ranged attacks, and many other abilities, forcing your strategy to evolve.

COLLECT ABILITY MODULES

Defeating ability-bearing enemies can drop their corresponding modules. Equip a limited set of modules to combine movement, ammunition, defense, control, and resource effects into your own build. Discovered modules are permanently retained by your operator.

CAMPAIGN AND ENDLESS DEFENSE

Fight through a 15-wave solo campaign with a special boss on Wave 10 and a final boss on Wave 15. Complete the campaign to unlock Endless Mode, where enemies scale without limit, carry randomized ability combinations, and unleash a boss every 10 waves.

COOPERATE WITH UP TO FOUR PLAYERS

Defend together in online co-op. Multiplayer uses a separate 30-wave run with shared construction costs, a visible loot pool, end-of-match distribution, and enemy and boss counts that scale with the number of players.

FAST, CHAOTIC, AND FUN!

Grab your hard hat and get ready to run!

Nail It Or Fail It is a high-octane, chaotic construction simulator where speed is everything and the environment is your biggest enemy. Whether you’re flying solo or teaming up with friends, you’ll need to coordinate, carry, and build under extreme pressure before the clock hits zero.

KEY FEATURES

  • ⚡ High-Speed Cooperation: Play with up to 4 players in local or online co-op. Will you be a well-oiled machine, or will you just get in each other's way?

  • 🏗️ Dynamic Obstacles: Construction is never easy. Navigate moving platforms, dodge swinging hazards, and survive environmental traps that threaten to level your hard work.

  • 🛠️ Master the Chaos: From sky-high skyscrapers to unstable volcanic zones, adapt your strategy to different biomes and increasingly complex blueprints.

  • Physics-Based Fun: Throwing materials to your teammates might save time, but one bad aim could lead to a disastrous (and hilarious) collapse!

Hey, I’m Nana! Welcome to my place—

Wait, don’t sit there! That’s a dango. It just happens to look a lot like a cushion. ( ´ ▽ ` )ﾉ

  • We get four time slots a day: morning, afternoon, evening, and night. How should we spend each one? Work on a game, study, pick up a shift, have some fun, head out, or get some rest? My energy, mood, and wallet would all like a say in the matter. With the dango and our friends keeping us company, let’s keep making better games together!

Here’s my workspace, where I learn new skills and work on my games. I gather inspiration, put together a plan, and chip away at development, one little step at a time. Buying the right assets can save us some work, too. Then there’s a demo to make, feedback to gather, and a game to promote and release. We might even team up with a publisher. It can all make my head spin, but getting a game out into the world feels so good. And finally, the most important job of all: crossing my fingers that lots of people will enjoy playing it.

My first ten games might not be perfect, but hey, maybe someone will love number eleven. What do you think?

And here’s where I kick back. I unwind, have some fun, and see if I can dream up anything for my next game. Speaking of fun, how about we play something together? …Actually, no. No more games. I’ve been playing way too much lately. I should get out for some fresh air now and then. Maybe I’ll find a little inspiration—or even make a new friend.

If I ever get rich, I’m buying a huuuge sofa and spending a good two weeks curled up on it, playing games.

Oh! I never properly introduced the dango, did I? They’ll be sharing our home, too. Set them up at their workstations, and they’ll help us make games. They’re cute, and they work hard. No funny ideas just because they look like snacks, okay?

I love collecting different keyboards, too, and every so often I feel like switching up my room’s theme. The view from the window is lovely, and there’s something so cozy about staying in when it rains. I really do love my little home. Come hang out with me sometime, okay? I’ll write down all the lovely little moments, and all the memories we make together.

Want to start this diary with me, right from page one?

P.S. If you add Nana’s Game Dev Diary to your wishlist… I’ll take that as a “see you soon.”

New content:

  • Continuous development and study

  • Minigames between activities

  • Make games with Nana_AI

  • “AI INVASION” battle challenges

In-game text is currently available in Japanese only.

Take Japan to the Top

Take charge of Japan's national volleyball team. Select and develop players, then lead your team into international competition.

Discover promising talent from domestic leagues, schools, and among Japanese players competing overseas. Train them into a winning team, analyze your opponents, and decide your squad and tactics.

Will you focus on winning now, or invest in developing the next generation?

Keep making choices as you pursue the top of the world.

Select and Develop a 14-Player Squad

  • Find national-team candidates from domestic leagues and among promising young players

  • Use team training and individual coaching to develop strengths and cover weaknesses

  • Analyze opposing teams and select your squad for international competition

Watch the Results of Your Training Play Out in 3D

Player attributes and team selection shape every serve, receive, set, spike, and block.

Watch the players you developed take on powerful teams from around the world, one rally at a time.

You can switch viewing styles during a match.

  • Full Match — Follow every rally in 3D

  • Digest — Focus on the score and key moments

  • Closing Stages — Move quickly through the early game and start watching from the decisive moments

Start a Match Right Away

Quick Match lets you choose two of 16 national teams and start playing immediately.

In Coach Mode, choose your starting lineup and rotation, then set your serving, attacking, and blocking approaches. During the match, use timeouts and substitutions to lead your team from the bench.

A National Team That Changes Over Time

Players develop, grow older, and eventually leave the national team. Bring in new talent, navigate generational change, and build your own history with Japan.

Write your own naval legend amid torrents of steel.

In this strategy and progression game, you will manage the economy, develop the military industry, maneuver across the diplomatic stage, and personally design every warship—competing with the great powers across vast oceans in a contest of wisdom and courage.

Say no to rigid, cookie-cutter blueprints. Your fleet is defined by you. The game features a rigorous attribute calculation system: weapon weight directly affects speed, while armor thickness determines survivability.

A rich variety of ship platforms: Choose from 8 basic hull types, ranging from highly mobile destroyers to awe-inspiring super battleships.

Highly flexible outfitting: Freely configure main guns, secondary guns, torpedoes, and anti-aircraft weapons. Balance mobility and protection to create custom warships perfectly suited to your tactical style. Heavy-gun light cruisers, torpedo carriers, hollow-shell destroyers, and other abstract designs are all supported.

Every battle is full of variables—but they have nothing to do with you.

Dynamic environments and engagement distance: Fighting in storms will greatly affect accuracy, while night battles severely test fire-control technology. You do not need to decide whether to conduct long-range bombardment or close the distance to unleash deadly torpedoes based on enemy and friendly configurations. That is the job of your admirals and ships.

Battle damage and pursuit mechanics: Damaged warships will suffer real-time combat effectiveness degradation. When facing a routed enemy, use your speed advantage to pursue and expand your gains; or, when at a disadvantage, retreat decisively to preserve your strength. This part is your responsibility—your telegrams can reach the frontline command center.

Master multi-dimensional warfare and build an unbreakable layered defense.

Carrier battles: A complete carrier aircraft ecosystem. Dispatch fighters, dive bombers, and torpedo bombers to break through enemy anti-air fire and deliver devastating beyond-visual-range strikes against enemy capital ships.

Deep-sea hunting: Submarine stealth values and anti-submarine sonar engage in a constant contest. Use submarine wolfpacks to pose a deadly threat to surface fleets, or deploy escort fleets equipped with depth charges to keep your shipping lanes secure.

Your gaze must not be limited to the battlefield. You must also focus on the evolution of the world order.

Control of strategic straits: Gradually seize control of 8 major global strategic straits, including Gibraltar, Suez, and Malacca. Choke the lifelines of global trade and gain abundant funding and strategic resources.

Dynamic diplomatic rivalry: Interact with 6 AI nations, each with its own development preferences. Seek allies and form defensive alliances, pressure weaker nations to seize territory, and explore special mechanics involving absolutely neutral countries.

Military-industrial trade: Accept warship construction commissions from AI nations, earn massive profits, and reinvest them into your own military industry. Selling large numbers of high-quality ship designs to AI nations can even help them grow.

Every warship and every admiral bears witness to the rise of your empire.

Dynamic admiral development: Recruit and train naval commanders with more than a dozen unique skills, such as “Precise Shooting” and “Damage Control Master.” Their attributes will grow intelligently based on their real combat performance.

War history and memorial hall: Every warship has its own independent combat record. When a distinguished ship retires or is tragically sunk, it will be permanently recorded in the national memorial hall for future generations to honor.

Research breakthroughs: Concentrate your resources to overcome key technology trees. Of course, research always comes with surprises.

Whether you are a veteran strategist who commands from behind the scenes or a new commander just entering the world of naval warfare, the built-in tutorial will help you quickly master the core gameplay. Enjoy the pure appeal of strategy and progression in a turn-based experience with no real-time pressure.

After all, giant ships and big guns are a man’s romance!

Defeat the Horde. Raise the Fallen. Lead Them to Victory.

You are Gu Gui, a necromancer of the Ghost Path who wakes in a flimsy coffin. Cast spells yourself and bind fallen bodies into skeleton soldiers. Let them charge into enemy lines and guard your back. Shattered skeletons leave piles of bones you can raise again. Your legion starts with a single soldier and grows with every battle.

The Horde Becomes Your Army. The Dead in Their Graves Are Waiting to Come Home.

The zombies in the horde have bodies but no souls; you can only raise them as skeleton soldiers. Those buried in the graves still have their souls. Reclaim the Seal of Return, and you can call them home. A'Cen the blacksmith wakes with the words, "I thought I'd never forge iron again." Lin He the carpenter builds your camp's workshop. Su Ye, Keeper of the Roll, enters every returning name in the Book of Return. The forge burns again, and voices fill the camp once more. Gather the remains you cannot raise, bring them back, and lay them to rest in rows of graves. Little by little, a burial ground becomes a place where someone waits for you.

Free Demo

Play the prologue and the first four chapters: the Boneyard, Greywell, the North Pass and the Fogmire Apothecary. Main and side quests are voiced in Chinese only. The interface and subtitles support 14 languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Hungarian and Greek. The demo lasts about 1–1.5 hours. Win your first battle and you'll see how your skeleton legion works. If you enjoy it, please add the game to your wishlist.

Cast Spells. Command Your Legion.

Cast spells on the front line while your legion holds back the horde. Edict: Rise, Edict: March, Soul Bell, Requiem and Ward Charm—every technique changes the battlefield. Yan Zheng's companion story gradually teaches you formations: charge through enemy lines in Arrowhead, or hold firm around your commander in Ring Wall. Switch with a single key.

Defend the Lamps. Breach the Pass. Cleanse the Poison.

At night, the horde surges towards Greywell. Lamps burn at the village entrance, each becoming a target. Defend them, then face the Well-Bound in the dry well. Head north and break through the pass. In front of the watchtower, find a broken saber inscribed with "Yan." Beyond lies the Fogmire, its paths sealed by poison fog. Soul-light is trapped inside three poison lamps; purify them one by one. Along the way, side quests and relics await those who stop to listen to what the dead never finished saying.

Companions

  • Lin Yuan—A ranger from Greywell: quick-tongued, quick to laugh, and fond of teasing. She knows every path with her eyes closed.

  • Yan Zheng—A saber captain at the North Pass. She died the night it fell, yet her unbroken will held her form together. She wakes with her blade drawn on you, calling you an evil sorcerer who drives the dead. Only after watching the villagers return home, one by one, does she accept you as a comrade.

  • Shen Zhi—A physician tending seventeen patients alone at the Fogmire Apothecary. She can tell you have "not a trace of life" in you, yet her first act is to lead you to extinguish the lamps.

Each companion has her own wishes and bonds. More companions will travel with you in the full game.

Story

Gu Gui, a necromancer of the Ghost Path, wakes in a flimsy coffin in a mass burial ground. His headstone reads "Erected by the Lamplight Bureau." The man who buried him was the senior brother he trusted most. The Seal of Return, which guides the souls of the dead back into their bodies, has been stolen and misused. Hordes of corpses now rise across the land. Gu Gui binds the fallen into an army, reclaims the Seal piece by piece, calls home those still waiting in their graves, and rebuilds a home from the ruins.

Necro-Matcher is a turn-based match-3 rogue-lite. You traverse a procedurally generated map, fight monsters by utilizing a match-3 board, and build up your inventory using the pieces, treasures, and potions you pick up along the way.

Your inventory of pieces appear on the board. Buying, upgrading, and swapping them changes the effectiveness of your build. Match them to attack, defend, heal, dodge, or trigger something special, while the enemy relays its intent to you. You only get so many moves each turn, so every match is preparation for whatever comes next.

Treasures are passive upgrades that gives your character passive and active abilities in and out of battle. Potions are single-use tools you can use to give yourself a boost. Each character has a unique starting loadout of pieces and signature ability. In this version you can play two of them, and you can find 30+ treasures, 20+ pieces, and 10+ potions along the way. Not every reward will be of use depending on your strategy/playstyle.

The map branches through battles, shops, rest sites, and random events that can make or break a run. There are three floors. An average run takes about an hour, and every run feels different.

The living see a battlefield. You see an army waiting to rise.

Necromancer: The Fallen Serve is a dark fantasy real-time strategy game built around one simple rule: death makes you stronger.

Command the Necromancer and lead an ever-growing undead legion against fortified human kingdoms, powerful heroes, mages and armies determined to stop you.

Slain enemies leave behind the resources of war. Harvest their bones. Claim their souls. Raise new warriors directly from the battlefield and turn the enemy's losses into your reinforcements.

Necromancer's Ruins is a 2D roguelike platformer where you explore magical ruins, fight monsters, collect treasure, and slowly become stronger between runs.

You play as a young treasure hunter who sets out to find ancient relics hidden inside dangerous ruins. Each expedition takes you through rooms full of enemies, traps, rewards, upgrades, and powerful creatures waiting at the end.

You probably will not survive every run, but that is part of the journey. Return to the lobby, spend what you earned, unlock new upgrades, and try to go further next time.

The game is built around fast platforming, simple but satisfying combat, permanent progression, and a colorful hand-painted fantasy style.

Forget routine resource gathering. Here, your guests are the resources. Harvest their parts to stitch together a loyal workforce and complete your magnum opus: the Perfect Being. This is a dark-sim with high viral potential and a deep progression system.

HOTEL RENOVATION & EXPANSION

Restore the hotel to its former glory. Customize rooms, select eerie furniture, and open new floors as your profits grow. Keep the guests coming and the silver flowing, you’ll need it for your research.

EXPLORATION & MINION CRAFTING

Explore every dark corner of the hotel and exterminate the local vermin and monsters. Create zombie minions from their remains.

GUEST MANAGEMENT

Satisfy your guests whims by matching them with the perfect rooms. But remember: you aren’t just a host; you’re a predator. Utilize guests to collect valuable biological materials essential for your scientific breakthrough.

THE LABORATORY

The heart of your operation. This is where you process your "finds." Decide whether a fresh limb is better suited for a new bellhop or if it’s the final piece needed for your Perfect Being.

Necrovoid — a grim tactical RPG in a post-apocalyptic world where every battle decides whether you remain human or finally surrender to the darkness within.


About the Game
35 years have passed since the nuclear war that tore reality apart. Rifts spewed monsters into our world, and the survivors learned to live among them. You are an ordinary scavenger whose chest was pierced by something terrible. Now you don’t truly die… but with every death you become less and less human

Unique Mechanics

  • 2d6 Combat with Three Stances
    Attack / Defense / Evasion. Every roll is visible in a detailed combat log. No auto-battles or RNG lottery — only your decisions and the luck of the dice.

  • Limb-Based Injuries
    Damage to the head, arms, torso, and legs actually affects your stats. You don’t heal abstract HP — you treat specific body parts.

  • Statuses and Counter-Moves
    Bleeding, poison, burn, stun. Each enemy type (beasts, undead, mysterious, water creatures, etc.) has its own weaknesses and dangerous abilities.

  • 3 Classes + The Abyss Branch
    Develop regular skills or fully surrender to the parasite and gain fundamentally different power (and consequences).

    Living Node-Based Map
    Every transition can bring an ambush, a rare event, or hidden loot. One wrong path and you’re in a pit with a spider queen.

  • Camp and NPCs
    Shadow (merchant and mentor), Devourer, Stepan, Yaga, and others. Their quests and dialogues change the story and your fate.

  • Two-Act Campaign + 3 Difficulties + Arcade Mode. Full nonlinearity and multiple endings.


    Atmosphere and Story

    You are searching for the legendary New Eden — the last place where pure land supposedly still exists. Along the way you will encounter:

    • The Infected Dark Forest

    • The Cursed Village “Quiet Ash»

    Every choice has a price. Will you tear the parasite out in a ritual? Will you accept the power and become a monster? Will you destroy New Eden or finally find peace there?

Neko Room Days is a cozy 2D pixel-art room-decorating sim where you create a home for cats and unwind to mellow lo-fi music.

Care for your cats, arrange furniture, or use the music and built-in timers while you work. Whatever you are in the mood for, spend your time in the cat room your own way.

A Home Full of Little Cat Moments

Your cats roam freely around the room, eating, drinking, playing, and curling up in their favorite spots. Pet and brush them, get to know each cat on their own terms, and watch friendships grow as they spend time together.

　　　　　

Make the Cat Room Your Own

Your life together begins in a compact studio apartment. Collect and arrange more than 20 types of furniture, including cat beds, towers, tunnels, toys, and a cozy kotatsu.

As your level rises, new places to live become available, including a traditional Japanese room, a high-rise apartment, and a resort villa. Each of the six rooms takes on a different atmosphere in the morning, afternoon, and at night.

Lo-Fi for Focus and Relaxation

Choose from six albums featuring 60+ lo-fi tracks. Skip to the next track, shuffle playback, or turn on repeat.

The Pomodoro timer and stopwatch run independently of the music and can be used at the same time. Let the cats and music keep you company while you work, study, or read.

Everyday Moments Become Memories

Your first time caring for a cat, the changing atmosphere from morning to night, discovering new rooms and furniture, and seeing two cats grow closer—these moments can all be recorded as Memories as you reach milestones throughout the game.

Let your cats take on part-time jobs and wait for them to come home, or hide the UI and simply enjoy the room and music. There is no need to rush. Spend time with your cats and make memories at your own pace.

A little company on your taskbar while you work

Switch to Mini Mode and let your cats step out of their room and onto your desktop.
Watch them stroll along your taskbar or curl up for a peaceful nap. Whether you’re working or studying, they’ll quietly keep you company.

Put on your favorite lo-fi music and make your everyday tasks a little cozier, with cats by your side.

Nemorsys is a punishing stealth-action RPG built on one rule: light exposes you, shadow arms you.

Every system reads the light. Your abilities scale with it, enemies see by it, and each room is lit so that the direct path is the one that kills you.

A frontal assault is not a playstyle here, it is a death sentence. Kaelara dies fast in the open. Read the light, put it out, and take the throne from the dark.

Your light is fading. Can you master the darkness before it consumes you?

Your pact grants an ever-shifting arsenal, and the darkness decides how much of it you get. The same ability is a whisper in a lit hall and a killing blow in the black.

  • Master a roster of 20 unique Shadow abilities, each one shaped by the light around you and able to evolve into more lethal forms. Combine them, reshape the battlefield, and find your own way to reach the King.

  • Darkness is ammunition. Snuff a torch and the room itself becomes a weapon: the shadow you create is the shadow you spend.

The Dynamic Fog of War is alive. It breathes and shifts with your vision, hiding threats inches from your face.

  • Light-driven detection: line of sight, distance and ambient light level decide whether you are invisible or already dead.

  • Relentless adversaries: forget predictable patrols. Enemies coordinate, react to disturbances, and hunt you down. If you are seen, you are likely dead.

  • No fair fights: the game is tuned to punish a straight confrontation. Every encounter has an angle. Find it before it finds you.

Every biome is a lighting puzzle with guards standing in it.

  • Traverse a Handcrafted Nightmare: journey from the gore-slicked Eye-Gouger Tunnels and the Darkened Light Temple to the imposing shadows of the King’s Castle. Every biome is lit differently, so every biome demands new strategies.

  • Weaponize the World: your blade is lethal, but the environment is your playground. Kill a light source to open a route, lure enemies into ancient traps, or bring the architecture down on those who stand in your way.

The Nemorsys grants power, but it craves control.

  • Wield the Light: Kaelara is no mere vessel. Master her 5 unique Light Spells to purify enemies and hold the abyss back.

  • Resist the Corruption: every use of shadow magic invites the Nemorsys in. Push too far and you are consumed, severing your connection to her Light Spells for good. Balance is a mechanic, not a story beat.

The King sits on a throne of lies. The shadows are calling. Will you answer?

Synthwave Music

Immerse yourself in the sounds of the neon-drenched 80s, featuring music inspired by your favorite synthwave artists - or chose your own music.

Retro Visuals

Experience a world bathed in neon, with a futuristic-retro aesthetic that pays homage to the iconic 80s visual style.

High-Octane Racing

Push your supersport cars of the past to their limits! Feel the adrenaline as you hit top speeds, execute daring jumps, and skillfully weave through traffic.

Diverse Environments

Race across a variety of stunning landscapes, from the glittering streets of Neo Tokyo to glowing mountain passes, scorching deserts and distant otherworldly realms.

But why, father, why?

🏁 Drive Dozens of Supersport Cars
Bring the 80s beasts back to the streets.

🏁 Explore Diverse Neon Environments
Race through cityscapes, highways, tunnels, deserts, jungles, and more.

🏁 High-Octane Synthwave Soundtrack
Feel the synths of the 80s rumbling in your ears.

🏁 Multiple Game Modes
Time Trial, Checkpoint, Chase, Endless – just pick your poison.

🏁 Compete on Global Leaderboards
Prove you're worthy.

🏁 Total 80s Immersion
From visuals to music, dust off your VHS tape.

🏁 Nitro Boosts, Jumps, and Bumps
Nail stunts, dodge traffic, and blast your way through the streets.

🏁 Smooth Driving Physics
Easy to pick up, hard to master – feel the flow of the never-perfect ride.

🏁 Retro Visual Filter Customization
Tune VHS grain, CRT scanlines, neon bloom, and others to your 80s eyes' liking.

NeoRunners is a cyberpunk comic-book roguelite deckbuilder where every run is a knife-fight for survival on the city's deadliest streets.

ENTER A PLAYABLE CYBERPUNK COMIC

Battle through animated comic panels, kinetic interfaces, and explosive scenes where characters break the frame and attacks reshape the screen. 

ENGINEER ELEMENTAL CHAOS

Build your deck around three interconnected elements:

🔥 Burn — scorch enemies over time
⚡ Volt — amplify devastating attacks
💧 Flow — disrupt enemy actions

Combine and manipulate their stacks to trigger Surge, Fracture, Disrupt, and other powerful reactions. Find unexpected card interactions and turn carefully planned setups into screen-filling chain reactions.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS THAT CHANGE YOUR RUNS

Meet a recurring cast of criminals, merchants, rivals, and strange allies.

Raise affinity to unlock new cards, modifications, services, story paths, and even new gameplay systems. Who you help changes what becomes possible in future runs.

BUILD YOUR DECK. CHOOSE YOUR PEOPLE. BREAK THE SYSTEM.

Neon Armada: Solar Storm is a top-down arena roguelite you can learn in a single wave and spend a hundred hours failing to master.

ONE WAVE TO LEARN IT

Left stick to move, right trigger for you special ability. Your guns track the nearest target on their own — so you are fighting from the first second, not reading a tutorial.

Prefer to aim yourself? Twin-stick aiming is in the settings, off by default.

A HUNDRED HOURS TO MASTER IT

Auto-fire is not auto-win. Your guns pick the nearest target, which means what you choose to stand near IS your aim. Positioning is targeting. Spacing is damage. The afterburner is your only real defense and it runs dry exactly when you need it.

Every wave sweeps in from all four edges of a single combat plane. There is no safe corner, no cover, no waiting it out — only where you put the ship next.

And no boss cares how good your build is if you have not learned the pattern.

SHORT, SHARP, RELENTLESS

Waves run thirty to ninety seconds. A world is a handful of minutes. Between every single wave the cockpit bridge comes up and the run autosaves — a real stopping point, every time.

Play one world on a break. Push for the whole run on a long evening. The game does not punish you for putting it down.

BUILD SOMETHING NOBODY ELSE HAS

This is the heart of it.

  • 32 ships, each with its own signature ability

  • 30 weapons, from kinetic auto-cannons to beams and flak

  • 115 mods to bolt into them

  • 214 items to stack on top

Spend credits. Reroll offers. Chase the one piece your build is missing.

MOD LINK SETS

Mods are not flat stat sticks. Every weapon mod belongs to a link category

— and filling a single weapon with mods that all share a category supercharges that weapon's output.

Mix categories and you get nothing. Complete a set and the weapon transforms.

Better weapons hold more: a Legendary carries four mod slots, a Rare only one. You can never hold two of the same mod in one weapon, so completing a set means genuinely hunting down distinct pieces. Drones run their own mod slots and their own set bonuses on top.

It is a build system where the third mod you find can be worth more than the first ten.

INVEST IN THE FLEET

Ten research facilities sit behind the shop — ARSENAL, DRIVE, ENERGY, AUTOMATION and more. Credits poured into them do not just buy stats: they bend the loot table toward the build you are chasing and scale what every kill pays out.

Decide what you want to become, then make the game more likely to offer it.

THE RUN

Burn outward from Mercury. Venus. Earth. Mars. Jupiter. Saturn. Uranus. Neptune. Every world is waves closing in from all sides and a boss at the end that fights by its own rules.

Then there is Planet X.

ENDLESS

Finishing the campaign does not have to finish the run.

Past the end, a wormhole generator starts aiming at places that were never on your route. Andromeda Rift. Cygnus Deep. Kepler's Folly. Draco's Maw. Three waves and a boss at every one, and there is always another.

A tier of gear opens up out here that appears nowhere else, built for a single purpose: breaking the ceilings your campaign build has already hit. Fire-rate limits. Shield recovery caps. The hard cap on how much a single hit can take off you. All of it comes off — if you are willing to pay for it.

Some of that power costs hull. Some costs hull and armor both. And the enemies scale exponentially from here, so your build has to stop adding and start multiplying.

How far you get is the only score that matters.

KEY FEATURES

  • Thirty seconds to learn, far longer to master — two controls, auto-targeting, optional twin-stick aiming

  • Short, intense waves with a shop and an auto-save between every one

  • Deep build crafting — 32 ships, 28 weapons, 115 mods, 112 passives, 102 items, weapons can merge and share traits

  • Mod link sets — complete a category inside a weapon to supercharge it

  • Drones with their own mods and their own set bonuses

  • Unlock 10 research facilities that steer what the shop offers you

  • A boss defends every world, each with patterns to learn

  • Endless mode with an exclusive cap-breaking gear tier and escalating risk

  • A distinct music track for every world you fight through

  • Strict top-down 3D combat, built in Godot 4

Pure Retro Arcade Insanity

Manga heart. Synthwave soul. Arcade fury.

Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade is a wraparound twin-stick arcade shooter built around rapid destruction, evasive flying and score chasing. Tear through enemy fleets, cycle weapons for Overcharge bursts and stack power-ups until your ship becomes a flying chain reaction.

Take on 100+ waves and 20 major bosses, solo or in 2-player local and online co-op. Chase a high score in Classic, or build a different run through Anomaly's risk-reward card choices.

Cel-shaded 3D spectacle meets the mecha anime and arcade shmups of the 1980s. A mysterious musical signal has awakened the dangerous—but suspiciously cute—robot Hollow Fleet. Join Lumi and Turbo Corgi, silence the signal and cut the chorus.

Go Fast or Get Hunted

Rapid destruction. Relentless pressure.

Every wave is a race against the clock. Destroy enemies without taking damage to build an 8× kill combo. Clear the wave quickly to bank up to a 2× multiplier for the next attack.

Take too long and surviving enemies break formation, become more aggressive and start hunting you. Keep moving, collect their drops and turn fresh power-ups into your next chain of destruction. Push deeper and fight for your place on the online leaderboards.

Classic Precision or Anomaly Chaos

Classic delivers a consistent wave-by-wave progression to learn, master and beat your best score. Anomaly changes the rules with a collection of 50+ mutation and Apex cards. Stack advantages, accept dangerous trade-offs and choose contracts that reshape boss encounters. Separate leaderboards keep the two challenges distinct.

Bring a Wingman

Share the insanity in 2-player shared-screen or online co-op, with cross-platform multiplayer, private and public lobbies, and Steam Remote Play Together.

Invite a friend, join another arcade pilot or add an AI-controlled wingman.

Multiple Weapons, Endless Firepower

Switch between three weapons, each built for a different combat situation:

  • Bolt: balanced, punchy rapid fire.
  • Lancet: long-range shots that pierce multiple enemies.
  • Pulse: heavy damage up close.

Firing one weapon charges the next. Keep cycling to unleash Overcharge bursts when you need extra damage. Boost out of trouble, then answer an overwhelming fleet with a screen-clearing Mega Bomb.

Stack and Merge Power-Ups

Collect and combine 13+ power-ups to turn your ship into a fleet-cleaving weapon. Duplicate pickups extend their duration; different types work together to create increasingly destructive combinations.

  • Rapid Fire dramatically increases firing speed.
  • Spread Shot turns attacks into wider triple-shot patterns.
  • Twin Satellites deploy two armed support drones.
  • Gravity Mines leave traps that pull enemies toward them.
  • Prism Rounds split into additional projectiles on impact.
  • Pocket Barrage continuously launches tiny homing missiles.
  • Salvage Magnet pulls nearby drops toward your ship.
  • Invulnerability lets you charge directly through danger.
  • Ultra Bomb doubles a Mega Bomb's damage.
  • Flipshot Drive turns your evasive boost into a deadly net.

Bosses That Actually Fight Differently

In Classic, a major boss arrives every fifth wave to close the biome chapter. Learn new tactics across multi-stage fights: bosses switch weapons, detach components, summon escorts, repair themselves or manufacture obstacles to protect their cores.

Victory starts a frantic bonus-loot interlude. Race around the arena and catch the scattered score pickups before time runs out.

The Fleet Fights Dirty

The Hollow Fleet fields 22+ regular enemy types, supported by six battlefield-control minibosses that change how encounters play out. Cut through thousands of enemies as physics-driven debris fills the arena around you.

Choose Your Pilot and Ship

Fly the Neon Breaker with Lumi: a durable all-rounder with extra weapons to match her trigger-happy personality. Or take the Dropzoner with Turbo Corgi: a fast interceptor with extra Mega Bombs for a pilot who loves speed and explosions.

Both ships reward aggressive play, emergency escapes and high-score runs, with different strengths to suit your style.

Five Living Worlds

Fight across Grid, Tide, Corona, Babylon and Vortex—five procedural neon worlds with environments that dance and transform with the music. Discover optional high-speed escape routes and watch for each biome's own environmental attacks.

A Kickass Jukebox

A 22-track synthwave soundtrack drives the action. Use the built-in Jukebox to choose what you hear, or bring your own music on Windows and macOS.

Unlock the Game Gallery

Explore an interactive 3D Gallery of weapons, pickups, enemies and bosses, with gameplay tips and unlocks. Browse illustrated Anomaly and Apex cards, track all 60 achievements and explore archives for the five worlds.

Comic-style Intel pages tell the stories behind Lumi, Turbo Corgi, their ships, the mysterious Signal and the pilotless Hollow Fleet.

Built Like a Dream Arcade Cabinet

  • Solo, 2-player local and online co-op.
  • Cross-platform multiplayer, private/public lobbies and Steam Remote Play Together.
  • AI-controlled co-op pilots.
  • Separate online leaderboards for Classic and Anomaly.
  • Dock with the Friendly Saucer for extra battlefield-shredding firepower.
  • Record, share and analyze your runs through replays.
  • 60 achievements across scoring, combat, survival, weapons and reckless flying.
  • Two gameplay camera modes and minimap support.
  • An arcade attract mode that takes over and plays when the title screen is left idle.
  • Configurable visual effects, 4K and 60–144+ FPS support.
  • Remappable controller, keyboard and mouse inputs, with extensive gameplay settings.
  • English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese localization.

Choose Normal for full enemy strength, online scores and all achievements. Choose Rookie for reduced enemy health, damage and fire rate, three continues and a smaller set of eight achievements. Rookie Classic runs can also be suspended and resumed later.

Come for the retro style and colorful explosions. Stay for the adrenaline—and your next high score.

PURE MOMENTUM, HIGH AUTONOMY, UNSTOPPABLE ACTION

It’s time to get off the ground. Immerse yourself in a futuristic, vertical world drenched in vibrant neon lights. You command two distinct forces: a high-velocity Grappling Gun in one hand to swing through the skyline like an apex predator, and a devastating arsenal of weapons in the other to turn rogue robots into scrap metal. If you stop moving, you die. Keep your momentum, stay airborne, and find your flow!

Key Features:

* Infinite Momentum & Fluid Movement: Master physics-based grappling mechanics to soar between platforms without losing speed. The ground is merely a pit stop-touch down for a split second to recharge your stamina, then launch yourself straight back into the stratosphere.

* Hypnotic Neon Aesthetics & Stress Relief: Visually striking, non-intrusive neon environments combined with a rhythmic gameplay loop create the ultimate "flow state." It's intense, fast-paced action designed to let you blow off steam and shred enemies effortlessly.

* Elite Skill Chests: Pulling the trigger isn't enough; you need to dominate. Reach specific kill milestones to unlock high-tier chests packed with game-changing active skills that will melt through enemy ranks.

* Dynamic Card Draft System: Adapt and evolve on the fly. Choose from specialized upgrade cards every time you level up to boost your firepower, extend your grappling reach, or push your mobility past its limits. Craft the perfect build for every run!

The Gameplay Loop

  • Swing & Shoot: Staying airborne is your best defense. Line up your shots and blast mechanical threats while swinging mid-air.

  • Adapt & Evolve: Select strategic upgrade cards as you level up, combining passive traits into powerful combat combos.

  • Unleash the Chests: Fill your kill counter, unlock tactical skill chests, and watch the arena dissolve into neon sparks.

A Turn-Based First-Person Puzzle

NEOSTALKER combines a first-person perspective with the turn-based logic of a spatial puzzle. What matters here is not reaction speed, but precision: where to move, what to activate, which path to open, and in what order to act.

After each of your turns, the environment takes its own: mechanisms move, robots react, dangerous zones block routes, and a mistake in the order of actions can cost you your life.

The Grappling Hook as a Tool for Thinking

The grappling hook is your main way to move and interact with the environment. Latch onto anchor points, change position, activate levers, valves, and mechanisms, and search for a safe sequence of actions.

It is a tool for precise planning: every grapple, angle, and transition matters.

Descent into an Autonomous Factory

In the future, humanity entrusted production to gigantic self-running factories. They were meant to preserve everyday life, evolve, and create everything people needed. But over time, something changed: the factories closed themselves off from people, the air around them became impossible to breathe, and machines threatening everything around them began to emerge from within.

You are a NeoStalker, sent where no one else can enter. Cross the factory's dangerous sections, reach its core, and shut it down safely to open the way for engineers and give them a chance to save the situation.

In 1983, in the city the influence of the criminal gang "Cipher" is growing. They are involved in the distribution of illegal substances, expanding their reach. Unconfirmed rumors suggest the gang is involved in a mass disappearance of people. However, this is attributed to the appearance of a serial killer in the city...

A neo-noir adventure game inspired by the films of Argento, Refn, and French cinema. The project is a first-person action game with light quest elements, visual novel elements, and hints of cyberpunk and neo-noir.

You will play as Leon, a member of a local criminal group, and Mylène Renault, a police officer. One is a criminal, the other a law enforcement officer, but this is not a love story; it is a gritty, psychological thriller, bordering on the insane at times. The story takes place over the course of one month, but it is not presented chronologically, so to understand the entire plot, you will have to be very attentive or play through the game several times.

Features:

An atmospheric action-adventure game in the style of retro games from the late 90s, combining elements of a shooter and a visual novel;

A cyberpunk, neo-noir plot with multiple characters.

Completion time: 3 hours, which is about the same as watching a full-length film or several episodes of a TV series in one evening.

Overview

Merge cards. Outsmart threats. Survive the collapse.

Net Raiders is a single-player game that fuses Roguelike Deck-building, RPG elements, and Strategy. Amidst the chaos of a crumbling virtual space, your choices determine your survival.
Merge cards in your hand on the fly to turn the tide of battle and break through ever-encroaching threats. In a world reconstructed with every run, combine cards, Engrams, and Consumables to perfect your ultimate deck.

Card Merge System

Don't like your hand? Then merge them! You can merge two cards at any moment during battle to turn the tables. Each card is assigned a specific Merge Type, and you can combine any cards that share the same Merge Type.

  • Enhance Merge – Evolve your card's performance. Amplify effects or alter properties to unleash their full potential.

  • Supply Merge – Create new possibilities. Immediately draw a new card in place of the one consumed to keep your momentum and seek endless opportunities.

  • Transform Merge – Turn crisis into opportunity. Convert unneeded cards into others in your hand to find the optimal strategy for the situation.

Condition-Based Card Effects

Simple approaches won't work. Most cards unleash explosive power only when specific "conditions" are met. Meticulously design your deck and satisfy these conditions to maximize efficiency.

Unique Characters, Unique Decks

Distinctive characters, each with unique exclusive cards and special mechanisms, are ready for you. Collect Engrams and Consumables to unlock their potential and push your playstyle to the limit.

A New Experience Every Run

The world of Net Raiders is reconstructed with every playthrough. Face changing cards, unpredictable events, and powerful enemies. Rise from countless failures and perfect your own "Ultimate Strategy."

Contact - obliqoninc@gmail.com

Net Worthless is a turn-based game about running one ordinary life like a small business that never quite breaks even. One turn is one month. You don't walk your character around town. You sit where they sit: in front of the plan, the bank balance, and the consequences.

It starts with picking a character. Each one is a different life with its own starting point, goal, and deadline: a student with more ambition than furniture, a laid-off office worker with a severance check and a grudge, and other people you might recognize from the mirror. Different constraints, different endings. In practice, a different game each run.

Plan the next 30 days: hours of sleep, hours at the desk job, hours in the gym, hours learning to code, hours doomscrolling. Take the job offer or hold out for something better. Enroll in a course, invest, finally cancel the subscription you forgot you had. Then end planning and watch the month play out. Paydays drop in, bills drop out, and about once a quarter life interrupts with an event you didn't budget for.

Inflation compounds quietly while you sleep. Rent doesn't care how your month went, subscriptions keep charging until you notice them, and a balance below zero digs itself deeper on its own. When you feel lucky, there's a stock market full of parody companies like Snoogle, Charbucks and Nokla. It can beat your salary for a year, then take it all back in one red month. The numbers behave like the 2020s. Only the brands are made up.

Get to know the networking devices you only see in theory. Open up rack cabinets in the server room and inspect switch and router interfaces. Grab the RJ45 ethernet cables, scale up the ports, and experience firsthand that establishing physical connections is the first and most critical step in data transmission.

Log in to a virtual PuTTY console terminal heavily inspired by industry-standard systems. Master the authorization process using the `enable` command, and implement fundamental network management practices—such as VLAN configuration, secure remote access via SSH, and NAT protocols—by entering your own commands.

Learn to monitor network traffic and make the right calls during a crisis. Read anomaly signals from the Cyber Threat Map, solve log analysis mechanisms, and apply the exact steps needed to protect the Server Farm within a realistic corporate scenario.

Grasp the logic behind security vulnerabilities. Examine popular exploit types like SQL Injection and XSS to understand how a system can be hacked. Gain a defense-oriented (Blue Team) cybersecurity mindset by applying security patches to close these vulnerabilities.

Build, defend, and take control. Neural Defense is a third-person Tower Defense where every match generates a different map, and you decide when to leave the strategic view to step inside any of your towers and defend it yourself.

In a future where an AI fused with a volcanic mineral is the target of a ruthless corporation, you're the only engineer standing between her and extinction. Build your defense network, survive the wave, and when things get critical — sync up.

— Tower Sync

Enter 3 of the 4 available towers and take direct control in first or third person. Automatic mode fires based on your configured targeting priority; with Tower Sync, you choose the target yourself, your damage increases, you unlock a special ability exclusive to manual mode, and you can switch towers mid-combat with a quick-access command, without ever returning to the top-down map view.

— Procedurally generated maps

Every match is different. You'll never memorize a layout. The system guarantees playable routes, but tower placement, obstacles, and chokepoints always change — adding an extra layer of difficulty along with the chance to boost your towers' range depending on the elevation where you place them.

— 4 towers, each with its own identity

Each tower has a unique automatic attack mode, expandable through two independent upgrade tracks: in-match progression and meta-progression between runs.

— 5 enemy types, including a wave boss

The genre's classic recipe, dosed in quantity based on enemy type and wave progression. Each enemy also has a defining trait that will force you to rethink your tower positioning strategy.

— Survival Mode

One of the campaign's endings unlocks infinite waves: hold out for as long as you can, with a meta-progression system that gives purpose to every extra run and extends playtime well beyond the story.

PHOTOSENSITIVITY / EPILEPSY WARNING: This game contains flashing lights, strobe effects, and intense visual patterns that may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

Neural Drift is a grid-based roguelike strategy game where you play as an artificial intelligence trying to grow, optimize, and earn as much money as possible.

Each run unfolds on a motherboard represented as a grid. Purchase programs, place them carefully, and use their unique effects to generate income, produce resources, or boost the efficiency of nearby systems. Every placement matters: a single program can become the core of a powerful engine, or the missing piece in a chain of escalating synergies.


But your AI is not just a machine for profit. As your system expands, you will face story choices that shape what kind of intelligence you become. Follow ethical constraints, bend the rules for efficiency, or abandon human values entirely in pursuit of growth. Your decisions influence the tone of your story and the identity of the AI you are building.


Discover new program combinations, adapt to limited space, and make tough choices about what to buy, what to upgrade, and what to sacrifice. Plan your layout, exploit your synergies, and decide how much of your conscience is worth keeping.

A one-of-a-kind fantasy 3D world built with Gaussian Splatting. It looks exactly like your brain feels: messy, noisy, and lost in fog.

Pick a goal. Dive in. See what the hell those Neural Goblins are up to.

Pilot a Brain Bubble Jellyfish through 11 mind caves. Explore sky-high nests and hidden shortcuts, track down five Neural Goblins, tackle minigames, and build a nest of your own.

More brain regions—and more trouble—are coming.

Pick a Goal. Wake Up Your Brain.

Step into a world ten years after the outbreak, where cities have been reclaimed by nature, vines crawl across abandoned buildings, and the remnants of humanity cling to survival.

In Never Be Alone, survival is about more than keeping yourself alive. It is about protecting what remains.

You awaken after a six-month coma inside a fragile and isolated safezone, with no memory of who you are or what happened before you were found. The settlement is vulnerable, its supplies are limited, and every person must contribute if it is going to survive.

To earn your place and uncover the truth about your forgotten past, you must venture beyond the walls, explore dangerous territories, confront the infected, and navigate uneasy relationships with the human factions still fighting for control.

The world will react to what you do. Missions, conversations, and outcomes can change depending on your actions, the weather, the time of day, and the people you save—or fail to save.

Will you protect your new home, survive what waits beyond the walls, and uncover the truth?

A Dynamic Story Campaign

  • Experience a fully voiced, story-driven campaign featuring more than 1,000 lines of real voice acting and over 30 main missions across three islands.

  • Help your safezone endure, form crucial alliances, encounter competing factions, and uncover clues about the life you lived before the outbreak.

  • Your actions matter. Characters remember what happened, react to mission outcomes, and may treat you differently based on the decisions you make.

Dynamic Missions and Replayability

No two groups will experience the story in exactly the same way.

Missions can adapt in real time based on:

  • Your actions and choices

  • Mission successes and failures

  • Survivors you rescue or leave behind

  • Weather conditions

  • Time of day

  • Previous conversations and discoveries

Objectives, dialogue, character reactions, and mission outcomes may change depending on how you approach each situation.

Seamless Cooperative Survival

Why face the apocalypse alone?

  • Team up with friends in seamless co-op, with support for as many players as the host computer can handle. Explore together, share supplies, coordinate attacks, travel in vehicles, and build fortified places to survive.

  • Whether you are playing as a duo or gathering a larger group, cooperation can mean the difference between making it home and becoming another body beside the road.

A World Reclaimed by Nature

  • Explore abandoned cities, forests, farms, military locations, survivor camps, industrial areas, and settlements slowly being consumed by the natural world.

  • The world of Never Be Alone spans three islands, each containing its own locations, dangers, secrets, and stories.

  • Search abandoned buildings, follow hidden trails, investigate forgotten camps, and discover what happened to the people who came before you.

Terrifying Infected

Face 11 distinct types of infected, each with different behaviours, strengths, and weaknesses.

Fight fast-moving Sprinters, four-legged Ferals, toxic mutations, heavily transformed Brutes, and rare creatures such as the Night Roarer—a powerful nocturnal infected that hunts after dark.

Some infected have survived long enough to undergo extreme mutations, becoming far more dangerous than the people or animals they once were.

Human Factions and Hostile Survivors

The infected are not the only threat.

  • Encounter military forces, bandits, scavengers, and other survivors with their own rules, territories, and motives. Some may be willing to cooperate. Others will threaten your home, steal what you need, or test how far you are willing to go to protect your people.

Immersive Survival Systems

First- and Third-Person Perspectives

Switch between first- and third-person views whenever you choose.

Use first person for immersion and detailed exploration, or third person for greater awareness during movement, combat, and cooperative play.

Fluid and Grounded Movement

More than 550 animations help make your survivor feel responsive, physical, and connected to the world.

Move through windows, crouch beneath obstacles, climb across the environment, interact with containers, and navigate abandoned locations with grounded character movement.

Dynamic Weather, Seasons, and Time

Snow, rain, fog, storms, and changing light conditions affect visibility, exploration, and combat.

Track footprints through snow and mud, use poor weather to move unseen, and prepare for conditions that can make even familiar routes dangerous.

The world also reacts to time of day. Certain missions, conversations, events, and infected may only appear under specific conditions.

Interactive Scavenging

Loot exists physically within the world.

Shelves become empty when supplies have been taken, items remain visibly placed where they can be found, and containers use animated interactions when opened.

Search carefully. What looks like an empty room may still contain the supplies that keep someone alive.

Crafting and Base Building

Gather resources, hunt, fish, farm, craft equipment, and construct defenses.

Build and maintain safe locations using generators, solar panels, storage, fortifications, and other survival systems. Power production reacts dynamically to time of day, weather, and cloud cover.

Farming and Food Management

Grow crops to support yourself, your group, and the safezone.

Protect the water supply, maintain the fields, manage harvested food, and prepare for changing weather. A failed crop can be just as dangerous as an infected attack.

Weapons and Customization

Find, maintain, and customize weapons using attachments such as:

  • Scopes

  • Suppressors

  • Flashlights

  • Extended magazines

Choose equipment that fits your situation, but remember that every shot creates noise—and noise attracts attention.

Vehicles and Exploration

Travel with friends, transport supplies, and use vehicles to cross the world more efficiently. Keep them repaired and fueled, because losing your transportation far from home can turn a routine journey into a fight for survival.

Character Customization

Personalize your survivor with different character options, hairstyles, beards, and clothing.

Create a survivor that represents you as you explore, fight, build, and uncover the story together.

See it. Become it. Transform into almost any creature you encounter!

Never Wither is an Open World Survival Crafting ARPG. Here, you will embark on a journey to collect creature companions, build thriving homesteads, and cleanse the entire world.

 

From lush river valleys to windswept plateaus, from frozen ice fields to scorching volcanic wastes…

Every corner of the continent of Edda is inhabited by fantastical creatures. However, a dark corruption stemming from the World Tree has tainted them.

Embark on a journey of exploration and purification, and become the last hope for this land.

 

 

From all-devouring Oozes to Mudballs that transform into farmland; from swift Wolf Warriors to stone giants who uproot trees as weapons—

Purify these corrupted beings in the name of the World Tree.

Incarnate as your companions, utilizing their unique combat skills and abilities, defeat bosses with precise maneuvers!

 

 

Combine and fuse the abilities of different creatures to raise a powerful team of companions.

Encounter rare special individuals with unique appearances or traits.

Gear up and venture into secret realms to find relics, conquer enemies, unlock powerful spells and facilities.

 

 

Gather resources and unleash your creativity to construct grand, fully functional temples.

Your companions are vital: they will gather, transport, farm, and defend against threats. Some can even transform into unique buildings!

Manage your residents and evolve your survival camp into a thriving, prosperous home.

 

 

In Edda, you won't be alone.

You can play in singleplayer mode, or invite friends into your world and embark on a journey of survival, building, and adventure.

You can also form clans on official servers, join battles, and fight for rich territories, or set your own rules on private servers and enjoy a variety of different experiences.

The shelves are yours to fill. Choose the games, arrange the shop, and get ready for the first customer. Buy used games across the counter, check their condition, and take the rough ones to the repair bench. Then pick a price and find them a new home.

Your floor, your call

Place your shelves and displays, choose what to stock, and decide which games get the good spot. Make your shop somewhere players want to browse.

Buy low, fix it, sell it

Flip the cartridge, check the pins, and make an offer. Take worn games to the bench for a clean and a fresh battery, then put them back on the shelf at your chosen price.

Work the counter

Help customers find a game, ring up their purchases, and count out the change. Keep the shelves stocked while the next customer waits.

Grow with the consoles

Build your business around changing console generations. Later-era content and long-term progression are being expanded as development continues.



Try your first days behind the counter in the free demo. Early Access is planned for December 2026, with continued updates toward version 1.0.

THE COLLAPSE WAS ORCHESTRATED. The fall of humanity was not a biological accident—it was a flawless coup. A ruthless dictator released an airborne pathogen, intentionally mutating billions into a rotting, mindless army to pave the way for his absolute rule. Now, from his heavily fortified stronghold, he governs the ruins, protected by a syndicate of elite human mercenaries. He thought his new regime was untouchable. He overlooked one crucial detail.

YOU ARE THE ANOMALY. You, alongside a rare few others, are The Immune—your bodies naturally reject the pathogen. To the dictator, you are the ultimate threat. Now, you are the hunted. But it is time to turn the tables.

A WAR ON TWO FRONTS Survive in a hostile, decaying environment where danger strikes from all sides. Fight off relentless waves of the infected, while outsmarting highly tactical, heavily armed human soldiers deployed to wipe out the remaining Immune. Every bullet, every shadow, and every decision matters.

SHATTER THE EMPIRE Mere survival is not enough; this is a rebellion. Fight your way through devastated environments, infiltrate guarded enemy compounds, and dismantle the dictator’s forces piece by piece. Gather your allies, adapt your arsenal, and use the remnants of civilization to your tactical advantage.

SYNTHESIZE SALVATION Taking down the mastermind is only the beginning. You must breach his inner sanctum, force the creation of the ultimate antidote, and release it back into the atmosphere. The very air that brought ruin will be the catalyst for humanity's rebirth.

Will you lead the charge, or fade into the shadows of the new era?

KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES:

  • Immersive Full-Body First-Person Action: Experience the horror and adrenaline through a highly realistic, full-body first-person perspective. High-quality, lifelike character models allow you to feel the weight of your movements, the impact of your melee strikes, and the recoil of your firearms.

  • Tactical Arsenal & Survival: Scavenge for vital resources in the unforgiving ruins of a shattered civilization where danger lurks in every corner. Find and utilize a variety of realistic weapons to adapt to any situation. Ammo is scarce, and every bullet must be counted to ensure your survival.

  • War on Two Fronts: Face unpredictable, terrifying swarms of the infected, and seamlessly switch your tactics to outsmart highly coordinated, heavily armed human mercenaries who use cover and flanking maneuvers.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Navigate through a dark, devastatingly beautiful, and hostile environment. Explore ruined cities and heavily guarded enemy compounds, using the environment to your tactical advantage.

Welcome to Next Acre, a cozy farming card and merge game where every card can become part of a thriving countryside economy.

Start with a handful of simple cards and gradually build a bustling farm filled with crops, animals, workshops, and production chains. Merge resources, complete orders, unlock new technologies, and discover increasingly advanced ways to grow your farm.

Arrange cards strategically, manage limited space, and decide how your farm will evolve. Every harvest brings new opportunities, every upgrade unlocks new possibilities, and every game tells a different farming story.

Whether you enjoy relaxing progression, satisfying production chains, or discovering efficient combinations, Next Acre offers a cozy and rewarding farming experience that you can enjoy at your own pace.

Features:

  • Merge cards to create crops, animals, products, and buildings

  • Build and optimize production chains

  • Complete customer orders and earn rewards

  • Unlock dozens of new cards and upgrades

  • Expand your farm and discover new strategies

  • Enjoy a relaxing, hand-crafted countryside atmosphere

  • Easy to learn, satisfying to master

Night Shift
The boss needs the product shipped before the deadline, so he hires people for the night shift at high pay — and you are one of them.
Your job: reviewing posts, organizing files, repairing audio.
Gameplay

  • Review posts: approve, delete, or move a post to the right board

Night Portable is a horror game set in a secondhand video game store in the 2000s, where retro handheld games, 3D night-shift survival, and an adventure through the past intertwine.

After taking a suspiciously high-paying night job, you are assigned to work alone inside the store from midnight until 6:00 AM for several nights.

Your duties should be nothing more than cleaning and restocking. But there is something inside the locked store.

Estimated playtime: Approximately 45–60 minutes Playtime may vary depending on exploration, playstyle, and the number of retries.

◆ FEATURES

■ WORK AND SURVIVE THE 3D NIGHT SHIFT
Complete cleaning and restocking duties while avoiding ■■■ as it roams the store. Light levels and footsteps affect how easily you are detected. Crouch in the darkness to conceal your presence, or risk making noise by sprinting away.

■ RETRO HANDHELD GAMES: SCORE OR CASH OUT
Play a variety of 2D minigames. Cash out once you reach the required score and secure your reward—or keep playing for a higher-tier prize while risking everything currently on the line. Rewards change each night, and failure costs you any pending reward.

■ BRING 2D REWARDS INTO THE 3D WORLD
Use batteries to restore flash charges, a radio to lure ■■■ away, an eyeball to reveal its form, an ofuda talisman to stop it, and a black high heel to temporarily prevent stamina drain. Knowing when to use each item may determine whether you survive.

■ A HANDHELD THAT BREAKS
Contact with ■■■ does not kill you immediately. Instead, damage accumulates on the handheld. The spreading cracks and glitches across its screen show how few chances you have left.

■ SIDE-SCROLLING ADVENTURE
Beyond each night shift lies a side-scrolling adventure through the past. Walk through old locations, investigate your surroundings, and relive events connected to ■■■ as you uncover the truth behind the curse linking past and present.

■ THREE VISUAL STYLES
A low-resolution 3D store with a retro aesthetic, handheld-style 2D screens, and a side-scrolling adventure. Three distinct styles gradually converge on the same haunting.

CHECK THEM

Check IDs, age, behavior, and anything they might be trying to hide.

CONFISCATE IT

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Each night adds new problems - hidden contraband, fake IDs, VIPs, groups, and changing rules.

FEATURES

  • Check IDs and decide who gets into the club

Night-Shift Nowhere is a first-person action-horror game set inside Nowhere Medical (a remote and deeply questionable medical facility) where your first night on the job goes spectacularly wrong!

You came here for a security shift. Instead, your boss is nowhere to be found, something has gone horribly wrong inside the facility, and getting through the night has suddenly become a very hands-on responsibility.

Explore the halls of Nowhere Medical, search restricted areas, piece together what happened, and uncover the truth behind the facility's increasingly disturbing medical practices. When exploration isn't enough, grab whatever you can find and fight your way forward with firearms, improvised weapons, and good old-fashioned workplace violence.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

What begins as a routine first shift quickly turns into a fight to stay alive! Scavenge for weapons, ammunition, equipment, and anything else that might give you an advantage!

EXPLORE NOWHERE MEDICAL

Offices, treatment areas, laboratories, restricted rooms, and places that probably weren't on the employee orientation tour are waiting to be explored! Search carefully. The deeper you go, the less sense the facility starts to make.

FIGHT YOUR WAY OUT

Sometimes running is the right answer! Sometimes the right answer is an axe. Use a mixture of firearms and melee weapons to deal with whatever stands between you and the exit.

UNCOVER WHAT HAPPENED

Documents, abandoned rooms, key cards, and environmental clues reveal pieces of Nowhere Medical's history and the events leading up to your shift! Whether you actually wanted to know any of this is another question.

WELCOME TO NOWHERE MEDICAL

The pay is terrible.
Your boss is watching your every move. 
Workplace safety has officially gone off the rails.

Whatever happens, it's officially the worst first day on the job.

BUILT WITH UNREAL ENGINE 5

Every night shift is different. Objectives relocate, weapons, light, and supplies appear in different places, and even the dialogue can change from run to run. Adapt to what you find and make it out alive.

BREAK THINGS. IT'S YOUR FIRST DAY

Shatter select environments, blast apart destructible objects, and send physics props flying when subtlety fails.

DARKNESS IS PART OF THE PROBLEM

Switch between flashlights, night-vision, or thermal-vision goggles while managing limited power and deciding which horrors you would rather see.

BULLET TIME

Trigger bullet time to line up devastating shots, react to impossible situations

BUILT TO BE REPLAYED

Escape in a focused horror-action run, then return to face a different arrangement of threats, resources, and objectives.

WALLS ARE ONLY A SUGGESTION

Hear something moving on the other side? Don’t bother opening the door. Punch rounds through select walls and surfaces to hit whatever is lurking behind them.... before it gets a clean shot at you.

THE FACILITY DOESN'T OBEY THE LAWS OF SPACE

Explore shifting corridors, impossible rooms, and a non-Euclidean maze that treats basic geometry as a suggestion.
