Nine Thrones is an open-world fantasy RPG inspired by classic tabletop adventures, set in a living world that doesn't wait for you.

Create your character, gather companions, explore dangerous dungeons, and fight tactical turn-based battles. Become a wandering adventurer, merchant, outlaw, military commander, or ruler. Your choices shape your story, but the world has stories of its own.

Beyond your party, autonomous characters pursue adventures, form relationships, follow personal ambitions, and face the consequences of their decisions. Kingdoms compete, fortunes change, and unexpected situations emerge as the world continues to evolve.

Speak with eligible characters in your own words using optional, locally powered AI dialogue, or enjoy traditional authored conversations. Discover a fantasy sandbox where the most interesting stories aren't always the ones that were scripted.

A WORLD THAT DOESN'T REVOLVE AROUND YOU

Your actions can leave lasting marks on the world. Clear out bandit camps, destroy hostile strongholds, or conquer settlements and bring them under new rulers. The consequences can extend far beyond the original battle.

YOUR AMBITIONS ARE YOUR OWN

You don't have to become a hero, general, or king. Build a fortune, become a notorious outlaw, travel as an adventurer, or become involved in the politics of the realm.

And if your ambitions turn toward rulership, you can rise to govern a city or castle and take your place among the powers shaping the world. Many locations can be conquered or destroyed.

But be warned: kingdoms and smaller factions are bound together by alliances and obligations. Conquering a small village might be easy, but doing so could put you at war with the powerful kingdom that claims it—and its allies.

A NOTE FROM RED TOWER STUDIOS

Nine Thrones is currently in late alpha, and we have just launched into Early Access.

The game is still evolving. Some systems are being expanded, new content is in development, and there may be bugs along the way.

We're a small independent studio with ambitious plans, and player feedback will help shape the future of Nine Thrones.

Ninja Noboken Episode 2 is a fast, demanding 2.5D ninja action game.

It begins in the city. It does not end there.

Dash, slash, climb and react. Survival depends on precision — every mistake matters.

The game pays you for skill

Eight levels of Expertise. You climb them by fighting well, not by grinding.

Each level raises your mana, your stamina, your damage and your critical chance — which means longer chains, more arts, harder hits, and the room to fight the way you actually want to.

Drop to Expertise 1 and your abilities remain intact. You still fight. You still throw. You just hit softer and your combos break sooner.

The game doesn't take your abilities away when you fail — it rewards you when you master them.

Play like a ninja and you become one.

Fight like a ninja. Get rewarded like one.

Chain your strikes. Launch enemies into the air and keep them there, juggling them apart before they ever touch the ground. Dash through danger and come out swinging.

Every combo runs on stamina. Run dry and you keep fighting — the game never takes the sword out of your hands — but the chain breaks, and a broken chain does a fraction of the damage.

The Bonus Stage

Between chapters, the game stops being a platformer for a moment.

A pure arcade minigame — a direct nod to the Shinobi bonus rounds — that you'll play six times across the run. What you earn is permanent:

  • Increased stamina

  • Higher attack damage

  • Higher critical damage

  • Reduced mana cost

  • Extra lives

Clear it clean and Kenjiro carries that power for the rest of the game. Fumble it and you go into the next chapter exactly as weak as you left the last one.

Seven ninja arts

  • Shuriken — the throw you'll never stop using

  • Great Shuriken — heavy, and it comes back

  • Triple Shuriken — three blades fanned upward at once, straight ahead and angled high

  • Rising Flame — a pillar of fire straight up through whatever is above you

  • Whirlwind — spinning blades that orbit you mid-air while you turn

  • Ice Tornado — a freezing vortex that tears through a crowd

  • Fireballs — three orbiting flames. For five seconds nothing can touch you, and anything you touch dies in one hit.

Every art costs mana. Choosing when to spend it is half the fight.

Shadows fight beside you

Summon your Shadows — copies of yourself that mirror every strike you throw. Keep them alive and a single combo can deal nearly triple damage.

A journey across seven worlds

From the streets where it starts, up a killing mountain, through a sealed gate, down into an underground maze, and into the volcanic fortress at the end of everything.

Seven chapters. Seven distinct environments. A focused action experience with no filler, no padding, and no wasted screens.

And the deeper you go, the less the ground stays put. Later worlds rearrange themselves between runs — carefully designed pieces, shuffled into different layouts. The route you memorized won't always be the route you get.

Seven bosses

Every boss is built as its own puzzle — its own tells, its own timing, its own way of punishing you for guessing.

Learn the pattern. Adapt. Strike. Or die and try again.

And the last one waiting at the end of the road is not going down the way the others did.

A story told between the fights

Fully scripted cinematics carry the journey from the first ambush to the last gate — allies, betrayals, and a thing at the bottom of the world that should not be awake.

Fully voiced and subtitled in English and Spanish.

Built on old DNA

Ninja Noboken Episode 2 pushes the first episode further in every direction — faster combat, tighter controls, harder encounters and more ways to master the game.

Born from Ninja Gaiden II on the NES. Forged by the spirit of the Shinobi arcade cabinets. Everything after that is its own.

Precise. Demanding. No filler.

17 achievements. Seven chapters. One ninja.

SURVIVE ON VERDARA

No Man's Mines is a survival crafting game I'm making on my own.

You crash on Verdara with almost nothing. Pick up sticks and stones, make some tools, get a fire going and find somewhere to build.

The planet is completely round. You can walk all the way around it, and you can dig into almost any part of it.

DIG ANYWHERE

Grab a shovel and dig.

Make a quick hole for some ore, dig tunnels under your base or keep going and make your own cave. Copper and iron can be found underground, with some deposits visible on the surface too.

BUILD AND SURVIVE

Chop trees, smelt ore and make better tools as you go.

Build a base from wood and later stone, cook food, keep your hunger and thirst under control and put down a bedroll in case things go wrong.

Just don't stand under a falling tree.

FIGHT OR SNEAK

Dinosaurs, goblins and orcs live around the planet.

Enemy camps have guards, archers and loot to take. You can fight your way in or crouch down and try to deal with them quietly.

Every few nights a raid begins and enemies come after your base. They'll attack walls and break their way through if they can't reach you.

LEVEL UP BY PLAYING

Mining, woodcutting, sneaking, archery and melee skills improve as you use them.

Your character also has a tech tree where you choose what to unlock next, including tools, building parts and crafting stations.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Play alone or with up to 3 friends.

You share the same world, including anything you dig, build, cut down or loot.

There's proximity voice chat, text chat and optional friendly fire.

Probably turn that last one off.

THE DEMO

The demo goes up to level 5 and covers the early part of the game, including copper progression, building, enemy camps, raids and co-op.
I am planning on adding more content and space ship building, this way you can travel to other planets as well.

If you play it, I'd like to hear what you think. You can talk to me or to other fellow players in the community tab.

Forget boss health bars. You win by having fewer cards than your opponent—and if you manage to empty your hand entirely when you win, that's a perfect victory.

Build familiar poker-style hands such as Pairs, Three of a Kind, Full Houses, Straights, and Four of a Kind, each with its own tactical effect. A Straight can help keep you in the fight, a Four of a Kind can shut your opponent down, and certain combinations even let you dump unwanted cards straight into the other player's hand.

A match might end with one perfectly planned play—or become a tug-of-war as both sides desperately try to dump their cards. The rule is simple:

Fewer cards win.

Actually making that happen is another matter.

Choose from a cast of animal card sharks, each with a completely different way to bend the rules. Copy cards, change their ranks, manipulate what gets drawn, or twist your hand into combinations that should never have worked in the first place.

Every character is a seasoned player with a signature technique—or, to put it less politely, a signature way to cheat. As your run progresses, those tricks can be refined into even stronger forms.

Unfortunately, the locals cheat too. The animals of Zhangyu Village have learned exactly one thing about card games: having fewer cards is good. So naturally, they keep shoving their cards into your hand. After all, the more cards you have, the fewer cards they have. Perfectly logical.

Can you get rid of your cards faster than they can stuff theirs into your hand?

Want to learn a few Chinese idioms while playing cards?

You have come to exactly the wrong village.

Every strange event begins with a real Chinese idiom—and the villagers have somehow managed to misunderstand every single one.

Take an idiom meaning “make your guests feel at home.” In Zhangyu Village, that obviously means welcoming every guest warmly... and then immediately sending them straight back home.

Explore the village, get dragged into these absurd misunderstandings, and decide whether to help, interfere, or make things even worse.

The Chinese idioms are real. The explanations absolutely are not.

Journey through 4 acts, with 8 distinct maps to discover across different runs. Collect over a hundred relics and pocket-sized tricks that can reshape how you play, then combine them with character abilities, unusual effects, and poker hands to create your own build.

Choose your route across the map and challenge opponents with wildly different rules. Decide when to spend resources, when to take a risk, and when an apparently terrible hand might actually be exactly what you need.

Every run asks you to rethink your hand, your route, your resources, and your strategy—and gives Zhangyu Village another chance to put even more cards into your hand.

Experience a true "Power Fantasy" progression. Start as a humble survivor gathering wood and stone, and evolve into a OverDeity who views civilizations as ants. With our fully destructible voxel world, your growth isn't just a stat—it’s the ability to physically reshape planets and shatter mountain ranges with a single talisman.

Interstellar Traversal

The cosmos is your playground. Explore a multi-star system universe where every planet features unique biomes and civilizations. Your mobility scales with your Divine Rank:

Early Game: Trekking and short-range flight.

Mid Game: Infinite flight and atmospheric escape.

End Game: Traversing black holes, and piloting massive Interstellar War-Barques to ferry loot across the galaxy.

Supreme Resource Gathering

Forget tedious grinding. Once you reach Lesser Deity, your efficiency skyrockets.

Use Artifact to instantly clear-cut forests.

Deploy Earth-Shaking Talismans to detonate and collect entire mines in seconds.

Store it all in your Spatial Sack—the cosmos provides infinite resources for those strong enough to take them and you need huge amount of resource in the road to OverDeity.

High-Octane Outpost Battle

Claim "Prime Resource" outpost through intense, large-scale combat. Slay waves of enemies to absorb Spiritual Qi, overcharging your artifacts to reach exponential power levels. Experience the explosive, high-speed combat as you defend your territory and expand your Sect's reach.

Co-op Sect Building

The path to immortality is better with allies. Join friends to:

Co-pilot massive Sky War-Barques.

Combine unique Builds (BD) for Synergy Effects that decimate screen-clearing bosses.

Unleash massive Synergy Formation to wipe out entire armies in an instant.

The Deity Style Automated Factory

Build a sprawling magical industrial empire. Establish Automated Production Lines to refine elixir and forge artifacts.

Divine Automation: Capture and subdue wandering Gods and Demons to serve as your Sect Disciples.

Management: Assign these powerful entities to manage your production units, turning your sect into a self-sustaining powerhouse while you focus on reaching the next Divine Rank.

The full game is out now! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.


Turn the route into a weapon

Your towers shape the paths of ground enemies. Keep a valid route to the exit while using corners, range and overlapping fire to build a defensive maze. Gold is limited: every new tower, upgrade or relocation changes your defense.


Pick a card. Shape your build.

As you advance through the campaign, choose one of three upgrade cards. Stack damage, attack speed, control or economy bonuses. Focus on your core towers or combine different strengths. Roguelite card choices and tower placement work together to shape how your defense fights.


The Battlefield Shop: adapt during combat

Match your spending to the incoming threats and combine shop purchases with your card choices. Opening the shop does not pause combat, so timing matters.


More towers. More challenges.

The full game features five tower types—machine-gun, slowing, flame, homing missile and electromagnetic—and ten specializations. Advance through three campaign chapters, combine different weapons and test your defense in Boss Challenge and Endless modes. Towers and modes unlock as you progress.


Play the free demo

Try Chapter 1's Campaign mode with machine-gun and slowing towers. Shape enemy routes, combine firepower with slowing effects, and choose one of three upgrade cards. Four cats have just pulled off a heist. Now comes the hard part: splitting the bounty.

In No Rest for Thieves, you and three friends sit around a table in the dead of night, attempting to steal as much money from each other as possible without falling asleep. Use an assortment of nonsensical, hilarious items to distract your opponents, make their eyelids droop, and keep yourself alert. One moment of carelessness, and the money you worked so hard to steal might just end up in someone else's hands.

How much will you walk away with? And how many grudges will you have to settle afterward?

Stealing Is Easy. Splitting the Loot Is Another Story

The heist was successful, and the goods are on the table. Unfortunately, none of the four thieves is particularly interested in sharing. Keep an eye on your friends' money, but don't forget to watch your own. There are plenty of wandering paws around the table, and everyone wants the biggest cut.

At the end of the round, whoever has the most money is the master thief!

I'm Just Resting My Eyes. Keep Your Paws Away

It's getting late, and everyone's starting to feel it. You close your eyes for a second. When you open them again, your money's gone.

Drink coffee to stay awake, then find a way to make your friends fall asleep first. After all, it's much easier to steal from someone who's unconscious.

Useful Items. Terrible Etiquette

Throw eggs in your friends' faces, stun them with a taser, or summon a tornado to scatter their money across the table. Still too orderly? Slam down a boxing glove and send everyone scrambling to recover their cash.

Some items help you get rich; others make it easier to rob someone else.

There Are Rules for Splitting the Bounty. Not for Betraying Your Friends

You wouldn't trust a thief, would you? Expect your friends to return favors with betrayal, break alliances without warning, make promises they have no intention of keeping, and turn on each other over a meager handful of coins. Around this table, anything is fair game…

Memories You'll Laugh About, Eventually

No Rest for Thieves is a small party game built around a simple premise: dividing stolen money among your friends. We hope it gives you an afternoon of dubiously good company, terrible decisions, and the kind of moments that live in long friendships. Especially that one friend who kept insisting they weren't tired, right up until someone stole all their money.

A Note from the Developers

The Demo: One Table for Now

This is an early demo focused on the game's core mechanics.

It includes one supermarket setting, four character designs, a limited selection of coins and items, and one basic game mode.

We're still refining the experience, and we'd love to know what you think. Tell us which moments made you laugh, which mechanics felt awkward, and what you'd like to see improved.

More to Come

We're working on more heist locations, unique items, game modes, collectibles, and character customization options.

For now, our focus is on getting the first version right. We'll share more about what's next as development progresses. If you like what you see, consider adding the game to your wishlist and sharing it with your friends.

For Streamers and Content Creators

Feel free to stream, record, and share your games. When posting, we'd appreciate it if you mentioned No Rest for Thieves in the title or description and included links to our Steam page and Discord, so viewers can find the game.

You're welcome to use footage from the game. Please make sure to label recordings of the current build as "Demo Gameplay." We'd love to see your funniest clips and hear your honest feedback.

The night shift at the distribution center was supposed to be just another routine job.
Check the packages, sort them, and don’t make mistakes: send the ordinary ones forward, and move the strange ones to reject.

But before long, the boxes begin to contain things that should never be there.

Each new discovery builds tension, and the familiar routine slowly turns into something far more disturbing.

You have to keep working, make decisions, and avoid confusing the ordinary with the things that should never be sent any further.
Every choice affects how the night unfolds, while random discoveries and different outcomes make each playthrough feel unique.

No Return Address is a psychological horror game where fear grows out of simple work, human error, and the feeling that something extra has found its way into the center tonight.

Features

  • Simple and intuitive sorting mechanics

  • Tension that grows with every new box

  • Different events and outcomes based on your decisions

  • Random elements that change each playthrough

  • A short atmospheric horror experience with a strong sense of unease

No Scope CEO puts you in the founder's chair of an FPS esports team. You recruit the players, develop their strategies and run the whole organization. But once the round starts, you're not the one holding the mouse.

Your players are far more than a few stat lines. How they answer you, what they are chasing and how they hold up under pressure matter just as much as their aim.

FROM FIVE NOBODIES TO WORLD NUMBER ONE

  • Create your org

  • Recruit your roster

  • Set up the practice schedule

  • Define the strategies

  • Land your sponsors

  • Upgrade your facilities

  • Become world number one!

WON ROUND BY ROUND. BUILT SEASON BY SEASON

The better your team knows a map, the further you can move past the standard setups and design your own plays. Tactics not your thing? Let your IGL handle the calls and focus on recruiting, training and growing your org.

WATCH YOUR DECISIONS COME TO LIFE

When the round starts, your players have to live with every decision made before the match.

Follow the pushes, the space they take, the gunfights, the rotations, the plants and the retakes. Sightlines, weapons, economy and utility genuinely shape how a round plays out.

EVERY CHOICE COSTS YOU SOMETHING

Every decision has consequences. Overloading practice can burn your players out, a clumsy statement can drive the fans away, and a losing streak can make your sponsors nervous. Results, morale, popularity and budget are tightly linked: your choices can turn a small org into a benchmark for the scene, or start a spiral that is very hard to stop.

NOBODY REACHES WORLD NUMBER ONE BY ACCIDENT

From the National League to the Continental League and on to the World stage, every tier puts tougher teams in your way. Each one has its own identity, its own stars and its own way of playing. Train your players, make the right decisions, learn from every loss and push past your limits. That's how you climb all the way to world number one.

一具遗骸没有姓名。要确认他是谁，你必须先还原一个消失近百年的家族。

上海一座老宅翻修时，工人在墙体夹层中发现了一具无名遗骸。没有能够证明身份的随身物品，没有明确对应的户籍或迁葬记录，也没有可供比对的亲缘样本。

案件被移交到历史悬案核查机构，而你，是负责认定其身份的法医族谱调查员。

从档案中寻找一个人

在办案终端中检索姓名、地点与事件，阅读旧照片、家书、讣告、报纸和官方档案。

记录不会直接告诉你答案。同一个人可能在不同材料中使用不同称呼；一份档案留下的空白，也许要从另一封信或另一张照片中补全。

重建盛氏家族

辨认照片中的人物，将姓名、照片和生卒年份填入族谱，判断他们之间的婚姻、血缘与代际关系。
